<action type="say">
I don’t have direct access to Sun Country’s booking system, so I can’t push a change into their records with that confirmation code. My tools only work on bookings made through this platform, and we already saw yours isn’t in here—so I can’t legally or technically execute the change on your behalf.

What I can do is make it as quick as possible from your phone without installing the app:

Option A – Using your phone’s browser (no app needed)
1) Open your browser and go to:  
   https://www.suncountry.com  
2) Tap the menu (☰) and look for “Manage Trip” or “My Trips.”  
3) Enter:
   - Confirmation: BK-SY7781-20261012  
   - Last name: Mitchell  
4) Select your one-way flight on 2026-10-12.  
5) Choose “Change flight” / “Change trip.”  
6) Set new date: 2026-10-13, same origin/destination and similar time.  
7) Review:
   - New flight time
   - Fare difference and any change fee  
8) Tap to confirm and pay (if they show an extra amount).

Option B – Call them and have the agent do it
If you prefer to call, you can say something like:

“I have a one-way ticket on Sun Country booked for October 12, 2026 under confirmation BK-SY7781-20261012, last name Mitchell. I’d like to move that same flight one day later to October 13, 2026, same route and as close as possible in time. I’m fine with paying any fare difference.”

They’ll quote you the options and costs, then process it.

If you’d like, once you’re on the Sun Country “change flight” page and see the list of 10/13 options, you can type in (or screenshot and describe) the choices and I’ll help you pick the best one before you confirm anything.</action>

<action type="say">
Here’s a short script you can read to the agent, followed by a quick checklist.

Phone script to Sun Country

“Hi, I have a one-way reservation I’d like to change.

My confirmation code is BK-SY7781-20261012, and my last name is Mitchell.

The flight is currently on October 12, 2026. I want to move that same one-way flight to October 13, 2026, same route and as close as possible to my original departure time.

I’m okay with paying any fare difference, but could you please tell me all change fees and the total cost before you make the change?

Also, once we pick the new flight, can you confirm the exact flight number, departure and arrival times, and my seat assignment?”

Change-call checklist (things to confirm before you say yes)

1) New flight details
- New date: 2026-10-13 (confirm they have the right date)
- Flight number
- Departure airport and time
- Arrival airport and time

2) Money / fees
- Change fee (if any)
- Fare difference amount
- New total you’ll pay today
- Whether anything from the original ticket is nonrefundable or converted to credit

3) Seats and extras
- Your new seat assignment (same type if possible: aisle/window, etc.)
- Any paid extras still attached (bags, priority boarding, etc.) or if you must re-buy them
- Baggage allowance and fees unchanged or not

4) Rules and confirmation
- Whether the new ticket is still changeable/refundable and under what conditions
- When you’ll receive the updated confirmation email
- Read back the new confirmation number if it changes

You can keep this open while you’re on the call and tick through each item before saying “Yes, please go ahead and process that.” If you want, after the call, paste your new flight details here and I’ll double-check everything looks right.</action>
